name: Solix
summary: Solix features a body finished in brass metallic paint, giving it a warm, contemporary glow with solid presence. The drawer front is wrapped in light grey matte elm veneer, adding a refined texture that softens the metallic frame. Inside, melamine panels keep the interior neat and structured, rounding out a design that feels modern and well composed. The body paint in brass metallic, drawer front panel cover with elm veneer in light grey matt inner panels with melamine. 150x45x78
